title: Wind and Truth
summary: The conclusion of the first arc of the Stormlight Archive arrives as the contest between champions approaches and the fate of Roshar hangs in the balance. Dalinar faces the terms of his deal with Odium, while Kaladin travels to the realm of the Heralds to understand the origins of the Oathpact and seek a permanent solution to the cycle of Desolations. Shallan journeys into the Cognitive Realm to confront her deepest traumas and unravel the mysteries of the Ghostbloods and her own past. The true history of the Heralds, the origin of the spren, and the dawn of the Cosmere's most significant conflict are finally revealed. Every radiant, every oath, every sacrifice culminates in a battle that will determine whether Roshar survives to see the next sunrise.
archiveDescription: The concluding volume of the first Rosharan arc records the resolution of the contest between Dalinar Kholin and Odium, as well as the journey into the realm of the Heralds to understand the Oathpact's origins. This document provides the most comprehensive account yet of the Cosmere's ancient history, including the true nature of the Dawnshards, the origin of the spren, and the events that led to the current configuration of Shardic influence. The revelations contained herein fundamentally reshape the understanding of Roshar's place in the larger Cosmere and set the stage for conflicts yet to come.
